a.lede: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has reportedly been dumped on its Switch 2 launch day, with its original release and a 23GB update already circulating online.
a.title: Nintendo’s latest Zelda remake already circulating online as a Switch 2 ROM

b.lede: Nintendo has released its remake of what is considered one of the best games ever made - the BBC's Tom Gerken gives his verdict.
b.title: Can the Zelda remake capture the magic of the original?
